name: Aspial Corporation Limited
summary: Aspial Corporation Limited, an investment holding company, operates in the real estate, financial service, and jewelry businesses in Singapore, Australia, Malaysia, Greater China, and Europe, and internationally. It operates through Retail Business, Real Estate Business, Financial service Business, and Others segments. The company is involved in the provision of pawn brokerage and secured lending services; retail and trading of pre-loved jewelry, timepieces, and bags; and branded merchandise. It also operates the jewelry retail business under the Maxi-cash, Lee Hwa, Goldheart Jewelry, and Niessing brands.
